verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs say users can put files into its VM, where it has a file system and a terminal and can write code to build the tools a task needs, so working with user-supplied files is plausibly supported. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents uploading documents, spreadsheets or PDFs, or describes analysis of their contents and its accuracy. missing for 10: explicit upload flow for documents/spreadsheets/PDFs, documented file-content analysis features, supported file types, evidence of analysis accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: All the files you put in your VM and everything Muse generates or uses on your behalf is stored there. You can inspect, edit and download these files freely
Muse has its own computer, with a file system and a terminal, so it can write its own code and build the tools a task needs.
